thesis: The episode argues that Large Language Models function by reducing complex realities into geometric manifolds, which allows them to reason confidently only within the bounds of their training data. Consequently, models cannot discover new science or generate novel theories because doing so requires moving beyond the specific state spaces they have been trained on.
